changes.headline: Benefit concert raises $8,000 for North Country Children's Museum
changes.detail: A benefit concert raised $8,000 for the North Country Children's Museum in Potsdam.

changes.headline: Natural gas odor reported at Massena Hospital ER entrance
changes.detail: Massena Fire was called for the smell of natural gas outside the emergency room entrance at Massena Hospital.

changes.headline: Threat reported on Tucker Rd, Pierrepont
changes.detail: A caller reported an individual threatening to burn a house down at 206 Tucker Rd; people were gathered out front when the call came in.

changes.headline: Car vs. deer on CR 38, Norfolk
changes.detail: A vehicle struck a deer at 581 CR 38 in Norfolk. No injuries were reported in the post.

changes.headline: NY-21 congressional race called for Constantino
changes.detail: North Country Now reported the NY-21 House race called, keeping the seat Republican as statewide results came in on election night.

changes.headline: Titus Mountain begins posting trail reports ahead of opening
changes.detail: Titus Mountain has started publishing daily trail and lift reports ahead of its season opening — the first of the area's ski hills to do so this year.
